patches_added.name: Unlock premium

patches_modified.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_modified.description: Replaces the dark theme background with pure black.

patches_modified.name: Custom accent color
patches_modified.description: Changes the accent color. Choose a color in the patches menu.

patches_modified.name: Hide promotional messages
patches_modified.description: Hides promotional banners, offers and pop-up messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide upgrade promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides the Upgrade buttons, upgrade prompts and the welcome offer after signing in. Plan limits still apply.

patches_modified.name: Material 3 switches
patches_modified.description: Shows switches in the Material 3 style with check and close icons.

patches_modified.name: Remove rating prompts
patches_modified.description: Removes the prompts asking for a rating.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks premium, removes ads and skips the upgrade screens.

patches_modified.name: Allow chat bubbles
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick Stock, Chat heads or Native Bubbles for floating chats. Needs Android 11 or newer. Chat heads also needs Messenger's own Chat heads switch, and Native Bubbles needs Messenger's bubbles allowed in Android's notification settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots
patches_modified.description: Lets you screenshot protected chat media, such as view-once photos and Quicksnap, and stops screenshot notices. It doesn't add replay or saving. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Auto reply
patches_modified.description: Answers messages with replies you write in HushMessenger settings, when they have words you pick or any message at all. Replies go out through Messenger's own notification reply, encrypted chats too, at most once every five minutes per chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Bold and italic text
patches_modified.description: Adds Bold and Italic to the menu that shows when you select words you typed. They're special Unicode letters, so they show on any phone, but screen readers may read them oddly. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Clone install under another package name
patches_modified.description: Installs a second copy of Messenger beside the first, with its own app name. Push notifications may not reach the copy. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Custom new-message sound
patches_modified.description: Replaces Messenger's new-message sound with an .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file (1 MB or less) that you choose. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Fix shared videos with xHE-AAC sound
patches_modified.description: Messenger can't send a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. When you share one into Messenger from another app, its sound is converted to regular AAC first, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI sticker tools
patches_modified.description: Hides the Generate AI sticker buttons, the AI sticker tab and AI sticker suggestions. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Chat Moments
patches_modified.description: Hides Chat Moments in the menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Facebook shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Hides Facebook buttons, profile and sharing shortcuts, and the Also from Meta and Subscriptions sections in the Menu tab. Handy if you only use Messenger. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Mark as read
patches_modified.description: Hides Mark as read in the menu you get when you press and hold a chat in your chat list, so you can't mark a chat read by accident. Mark as unread stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI
patches_modified.description: Hides the Meta AI floating button, toolbar button, tab and menu entries, plus AI in search and in @ suggestions. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Notifications tab
patches_modified.description: Hides the Notifications tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide People You May Know
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested people in chats, search and stories, and on the People and Notifications tabs, so you only see people you know. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide People tab
patches_modified.description: Hides the People tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels badge
patches_modified.description: Hides the Reels notification badge. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide ad banners in business chats
patches_modified.description: In a chat you started from a business's ad, hides the banner that shows that ad. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide avatar stickers
patches_modified.description: Hides the avatar tab in the sticker keyboard. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide business reply suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested replies in conversations with businesses. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide business typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides business suggestions that pop up as you type. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides promotion banners inside conversations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide event prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides event promotion prompts inside chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide friend request cards
patches_modified.description: Hides friend request cards in your chat list so they stop taking up room. It doesn't accept or decline anyone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide growth prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides prompts to add more people, the tip sheets in notes (like Make my notes public), and the Share your own story card after someone else's stories. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox ads
patches_modified.description: Hides ad cards in your chat list. Meta stopped selling Messenger inbox ads in November 2025, so this is only a safeguard in case they come back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides promotion banners in your chat list. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides the Home and Channels tabs inside your inbox. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide joined community chats
patches_modified.description: Hides the community chats you joined from your main chat list. Search and community folders still show them. Messages and unread counts don't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide read receipts
patches_modified.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you read their message, and the chat stays unread on this phone. Marking it read yourself or replying in it marks it read and shows Seen, like Messenger does. Group chats aren't tested. Messenger's own Read receipts setting under Privacy & safety marks chats read without showing Seen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide stories and notes
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories and notes above your chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide typing indicator
patches_modified.description: Stops Messenger from showing others when you're typing, even in end-to-end encrypted chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Install beside Meta apps
patches_modified.description: Lets your patched Messenger install next to Facebook and other Meta apps. Without it, the apps can clash over shared permissions and the install can stop at a blank screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Keep a message log
patches_modified.description: Saves each message when its notification arrives, so you can still read it if it's unsent. Works in end-to-end encrypted chats too. Stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep emoji search on emoji
patches_modified.description: Typing while the emoji keyboard is open no longer jumps to sticker search. The keyboard stays on emoji. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep unsent messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps messages on screen after someone unsends them, in chats where it works. Encrypted chats aren't supported, and group chats aren't tested. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Material You theme
patches_modified.description: Colors Messenger's dark mode with your wallpaper colors on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue on Android 11. Light mode stays the same. Turn on dark mode in Messenger first. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Open settings from menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, and makes a long press on the Messenger logo at the top of Chats or on the Menu tab's title open these settings too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Open web links externally
patches_modified.description: Opens web links (http and https) in your default browser instead of inside Messenger. Other link types work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Pin more chats
patches_modified.description: Raises Messenger's limit of three pinned chats to 20, so you can keep more chats at the top of your chat list. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Restore old emoji drawer
patches_modified.description: Turns off Meta's redesigned emoji keyboard, so you keep the earlier layout. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Meta never gave you the redesign, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Patching and signing Messenger yourself can break some of its screens. This makes Messenger's signature check pass again, including for a Facebook you patched with the same key. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Save any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the More options menu on other people's stories, so you can keep their photo or video on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Send photos at original quality
patches_modified.description: With HD on, sends a JPEG photo as the original image instead of Messenger's recompressed copy, so it stays sharper. Photos over 20 MB are still compressed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Send videos without re-encoding
patches_modified.description: Sends a video as the original file instead of a recompressed copy, when Messenger allows it. Videos over 25 MB, edited videos and some formats are still compressed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Slide chats in and out
patches_modified.description: Slides a chat in from the side when you open it and back out when you go back. Chat heads and bubbles keep their own animations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Spoof package version
patches_modified.description: Gives Messenger a high version number so the Play Store stops offering Meta's updates. Messenger may report it to Meta. Going back means uninstalling first, which erases its data. Pick it in Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Stop MQTT logging
patches_modified.description: Drops the health reports and push logging Messenger's MQTT client sends. Messenger sends most of its traffic another way, so there's often little for it to drop. Messages, calls and active status keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Drops the health reports and push logging Messenger's MQTT client sends. Messenger 582 sends most of its traffic another way, so there's often little for it to drop. Messages, calls and active status keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop ad attribution uploads
patches_modified.description: Stops the job that reads your phone's advertising ID and sends it to Meta with your ad tracking setting. The ID itself doesn't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop analytics uploads
patches_modified.description: Stops the background services Messenger uses to upload usage statistics. It still records them on your phone, and they can upload after you turn this off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop inbox and ad link logging
patches_modified.description: Stops two reports Messenger logs. One says which part of your chat list was on screen, which Messenger files under inbox ads. The other says which ad brought you in when a link from an ad opens a chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop nearby scans
patches_modified.description: Stops Messenger from reading the list of Wi-Fi networks around you. Also stops the timer it can run while it's open to check your location and scan for Wi-Fi networks and Bluetooth devices. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Turn off the swipe up for disappearing messages
patches_modified.description: Swiping up at the bottom of a chat no longer turns on disappearing messages, so a scroll can't set the timer by accident. You can still change it in the chat's settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Unlock app icons
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick any icon in Messenger's App icon setting without a subscription. Messenger still decides whether that setting shows for your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Use system emoji
patches_modified.description: Shows emoji in your phone's own style instead of Messenger's. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Use the phone's camera app
patches_modified.description: The camera button in a chat opens your phone's own camera app. The photo then opens in Messenger's editor, ready to send. Photos only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Use your own font
patches_modified.description: Shows Messenger's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a .ttf or .otf file you pick in HushMessenger settings. Emoji don't change. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: View stories anonymously
patches_modified.description: Opens other people's stories without adding you to their viewer list. Messenger still marks them as seen on your side. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Only One Free Store
patches_modified.description: Makes 'Restore Purchases' grant every store item for free (Ultimate Power, all classes, bundles and powers) — also removes ads.

patches_modified.name: Only One IAP billing bypass
patches_modified.description: Buy any item in the shop for free. When you tap Buy, the item is added to your game right away — no Google Play payment window ever opens.

patches_modified.name: Only One PairIP removal
patches_modified.description: Disables the PairIP license check so the game starts without Google Play licensing, error dialogs or forced exits.

patches_modified.name: All items owned
patches_modified.description: Every gun, skin, glove and drone shows as unlocked, and you can equip any of them. Your save file is not changed.

patches_modified.name: Instant rewarded video
patches_modified.description: Reward buttons pay out instantly. Tap once and you get the reward, with no ad to watch.

patches_modified.name: Unlimited currency
patches_modified.description: Your cash, gold and diamonds always show the maximum. You never run short of money.

patches_added.name: Swift Backup Local Cloud Metadata
patches_added.description: Makes cloud backups work by keeping their metadata on the device and the connected cloud instead of the Swift Backup server.

patches_added.description: Stops the pop-up with an image, a text and a button that the app shows on the home screen for surveys and notices, including forms you already answered.

patches_modified.description: Forces a true black AMOLED theme across all Stickerly screens, Jetpack Compose UI, dialogs, and bottom sheets.

patches_modified.description: Adds more ways to save: pick the video quality, save full-size photos, the sound on its own or a photo post as one video, hold a profile picture or story to save it, save a story or a video's cover from the share sheet, and pick videos on a profile grid to save in one run. The same page has Keep drafts on this phone, so unsent drafts stop syncing to your other devices, and Keep searches on this phone, so what you type in the main search isn't sent to Telegram. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps Telegram from looking up a link's preview before you send the message. Sent messages still get a preview. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Faster downloads
patches_modified.description: Downloads files in 512 KB pieces, 8 at a time, the way Telegram already does for accounts its servers pick, instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. If a big piece fails, Telegram still drops back to small ones. A second switch, Hold automatic downloads on Data Saver, keeps Telegram from downloading media on its own while Android's Data Saver is on and the network is metered. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Downloads files in 512 KB pieces, 8 at a time, the way Telegram already does for accounts its servers pick, instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. If a big piece fails, Telegram still drops back to small ones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Hide Contacts tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Contacts tab from the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. A second switch, Compact bottom bar, makes that bar shorter and only as wide as its tabs need. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the Contacts tab from the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide folder tab counters
patches_modified.description: Hides the unread count on each folder tab above the chat list, for a calmer look. A second switch, Open a folder at launch, opens the chat list on a folder you pick instead of All Chats. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the unread count on each folder tab above the chat list, for a calmer look. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Hide phone number
patches_modified.description: Covers your own phone number with dots in Settings and your profile, which helps when you share your screen. A second switch, Don't share my number by default, leaves the share-my-number box clear when you add someone as a contact from their chat. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.
patches_modified.previous_description: Covers your own phone number with dots in the side menu, Settings and your profile, which helps when you share your screen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide popular apps
patches_modified.description: Hides the Popular apps list on the Apps tab of search and stops Telegram from loading it. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads. Two more switches there start off. Search only my chats keeps search to your own chats and contacts, with nothing public. Find names in styled letters finds names written in decorative letters when you type plain ones.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the Popular apps list on the Apps tab of search and stops Telegram from loading it. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches_modified.name: Holiday look all year
patches_modified.description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel. The same page has Emoji next to the chat list title, which puts an emoji or a few letters of your choice after Telegram's name, on this phone only.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Opens ordinary web links in your browser instead of inside Telegram. Telegram links, sign-in and payment pages work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links. A second switch there, Keep your location from Mini Apps, starts off. With it on, Mini Apps and web pages opened in Telegram are told your location isn't available.
patches_modified.previous_description: Opens ordinary web links in your browser instead of inside Telegram. Telegram links, sign-in and payment pages work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.

patches_modified.name: Play voice messages one at a time
patches_modified.description: Stops the next voice or video message from playing by itself when one ends. A second switch, Keep voice messages quiet while locked, stops voice and round video messages from starting while your phone is locked. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops the next voice or video message from playing by itself when one ends. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Repair Firebase push registration
patches_modified.description: Tries to help a patched Telegram sign up for push notifications, by giving Google's Firebase service Telegram's original certificate. If Telegram's server still turns the sign-up down, as it does with your own API ID, it turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection instead, unless you've set either one yourself. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.
patches_modified.previous_description: Tries to help a patched Telegram sign up for push notifications, by giving Google's Firebase service Telegram's original certificate. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Strip link tracking
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags like utm_source, gclid and fbclid from links you open or share. Links with any other extra part stay unchanged. A second switch, No automatic sign-in on Telegram's sites, opens links to Telegram's own websites without the sign-in token Telegram adds for your account. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes tracking tags like utm_source, gclid and fbclid from links you open or share. Links with any other extra part stay unchanged. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.

patches_modified.name: Translate with an outside service
patches_modified.description: Adds Translate here to a message's menu and Translate this chat to a chat's menu. Text you turn on goes to Google's web translate, or to an AI service with your own key if you set one, one message at a time, and nothing is sent before that. With an AI service, a How to translate box lets you say how you want it done. Telegram's own translation and its Premium checks stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches_added.name: Show a reel's exact time
patches_added.description: Adds the date and time a reel was posted under the author's name, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, with seconds if you want them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_added.name: Tap a feed video to pause it
patches_added.description: A tap on the video playing in a feed pauses it in place instead of opening it in Reels. Ads keep Instagram's own tap. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_added.name: Font
patches_added.description: Lets you pick the font Instagram's text uses: Instagram's own, your phone's, or a .ttf or .otf file. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts on Instagram's font. Pick one in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_added.name: Hide AI-labeled reels
patches_added.description: Leaves out reels that carry Instagram's own AI label. A reel without that label stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Accent color
patches_modified.description: Swaps Instagram's blue on Follow buttons, links and other highlights for purple, pink, red, orange, green or teal. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots
patches_modified.description: Lets you take screenshots and record your screen where Instagram normally blocks it, such as disappearing photos and videos in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a call
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before a call starts from a chat, so a stray tap on the call button doesn't ring anyone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a like
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before the Like button under a post likes or unlikes it, so a stray tap doesn't do it for you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a refresh
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before pulling down refreshes Home, Reels or another list, so an accidental pull doesn't replace what you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Back leaves Home
patches_modified.description: Makes Back on Home leave Instagram at once, instead of first scrolling the feed to the top and reloading it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Blur the bars around Reels
patches_modified.description: Shows a blurred copy of a reel above and below it, or beside it, where Instagram would leave black bars. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Change the like animation
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick the animation that plays when you double tap a post to like it. The choices are animations Instagram made for its Rings creators. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Change version code
patches_modified.description: Stops Google Play from offering Meta's updates over your patched Instagram. Going back to the normal Instagram later means uninstalling first, which deletes its data. Later HushGram builds need this patch too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity, the Add a comment bar, the reply bar on reels from chats, the Save button and the Reels tab's top bar. Each one has its own switch, and Burn-in guard can dim a reel's buttons while you aren't touching the screen. Keep clear mode on carries Instagram's clear mode to the next reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity, the Add a comment bar, the Save button and the Reels tab's top bar. Each one has its own switch, and Burn-in guard can dim a reel's buttons while you aren't touching the screen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Clear the media cache
patches_modified.description: Frees storage by deleting Instagram's saved copies of photos and videos once they pass 500 MB. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay. A row clears them right away. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Storage.

patches_modified.name: Control taps and volume on Reels
patches_modified.description: Lets you choose what a single tap on a reel does: Instagram's default, pause, or mute. Can also keep a reel muted when you press volume up. Both start at Instagram's behavior. Choose them in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Copy comment
patches_modified.description: Adds Copy and Copy username to the menu you get on a comment, so you can copy its text or the commenter's username. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Data saver
patches_modified.description: Saves mobile data by loading smaller photos and starting videos at the lowest quality. It uses Full resolution photos and Default playback quality, so it turns both on. It starts with mobile data only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Default playback quality
patches_modified.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays. Nothing changes until you pick a quality. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from sending usage reports and crash reports to Instagram and Facebook. It also skips the contacts and location setup screens. Restart Instagram after you change it. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Don't report screenshots
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from telling people when you take a screenshot of their disappearing photo or video. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Don't save recent searches
patches_modified.description: Keeps the accounts and tags you open from search out of your Recent list. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches_modified.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from learning which reels you watched and how far you got. Reels you've already watched may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Download any reel
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture, the largest one the post carries. Download as video on a carousel with music saves every page, in order. A separate switch under Downloads puts a download icon under Save beside each reel. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture, the largest one the post carries. Download as video on a carousel with music saves every page, in order. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Download any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. Videos save at the quality you choose and photos at their largest size. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Download any video
patches_modified.description: Adds Download to video posts in your feed, saving the video without Instagram's watermark. Other switches add Download for photos, Download cover, a Details row with the post's time and poster, a download icon beside Save under each post, and Hold to download, which saves a post or reel you hold two fingers on. Download all waits its turn, with up to ten posts queued, so two posts' pages never mix in your gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Download voice messages
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the menu you get when you hold a voice message in a chat. It saves the recording as an audio file. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Emoji style
patches_modified.description: Shows every emoji in Google's style instead of your phone's own. The full change shows after you restart Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: Find the reel you came from
patches_modified.description: Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it for a moment. Stop looking ends the search, and Wait for a tap to find it holds it until you tap Find the reel. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Full resolution photos
patches_modified.description: Loads photos in the largest size Instagram sends instead of one picked for your screen. A second switch asks for a larger size on screens under 1440 pixels wide. Uses more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Full screen Reels and Home
patches_modified.description: Hides the status bar and the navigation bar while Reels shows, and optionally while Home does. Swipe in from the edge to bring them back for a moment. Back and the keyboard work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels (Full screen Reels) and Feed (Full screen Home).

patches_modified.name: Glass tab bar
patches_modified.description: Draws the tab bar as a floating, rounded pill of frosted glass that blurs what's behind it (Android 12 and newer), with a highlight on the tab you're on. Content can optionally run down behind it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Tab bar, then restart Instagram.

patches_modified.name: Group Instagram's notifications
patches_modified.description: Puts Instagram's notifications in one group, or in a group for each type, so they don't fill your notification shade. Tapping one still opens it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Hide Instants
patches_modified.description: Takes the stack of Instants out of your messages. Instants is Instagram's no-edit camera for sharing quick photos with friends. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI
patches_modified.description: Removes Meta AI from Instagram's search bars, messages, home top bar, reels menus, share sheet and feed. Each part has its own switch. The search one and the Meta AI posts one start on, the rest start off. Change them in HushGram settings > Meta AI.

patches_modified.name: Hide Notes on profile pictures
patches_modified.description: Takes the Notes bubble off profile pictures, yours included. Notes in Messages stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches_modified.description: Removes the rows of suggested reels from your home feed. A reel posted by someone you follow stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Hides sponsored posts, reels and stories, and leaves no gap where an ad would have been. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide comments
patches_modified.description: Takes the Comment button and the comment count off posts in your feed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide group buttons on the share sheet
patches_modified.description: Takes the New group button and the button that sends to several people as a group off the share sheet. You can still start a group from your messages. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches_modified.name: Hide highlights
patches_modified.description: Takes the row of story highlights off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts and posts stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide paid partnership Reels
patches_modified.description: Leaves out reels with a Paid partnership label, and reels Instagram marks as boosted. Ads have their own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts in DMs
patches_modified.description: Takes the Accounts to follow section off the bottom of your messages. Your chats and follow requests stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts in Reels
patches_modified.description: Leaves out the cards of accounts to follow that Instagram puts between reels. Every reel still plays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested people on profiles
patches_modified.description: Takes Suggested for you and the Discover people button off profiles. Bios, counts and posts stay. More switches take Suggested for you off the followers and following lists, the Complete your profile cards off your own profile and People you don't follow back off your notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide your active status

patches_modified.name: HushGram launch screen
patches_modified.description: Shows HushGram's logo instead of Instagram's on the screen you see while Instagram starts, on Android 13 and newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: Install next to Instagram
patches_modified.description: Installs this build as a second Instagram beside your normal one, with its own data and sign-in. Pick its package name and app name in the patch's options, and whether its icon gets a HushGram badge. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Keep Reels auto scroll on
patches_modified.description: Keeps Instagram's auto scroll in Reels turned on after you leave Reels or restart Instagram, until you turn it off yourself. patches_modified.name: Keep a seek bar on Reels
patches_modified.description: Keeps a seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Keep in chat
patches_modified.description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats after you open them, so they don't disappear. A photo or video you send stays Instagram's own sent bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Keep the reel speed
patches_modified.description: Keeps the 2x speed on for the next reels after you lock a reel at 2x (hold its edge, then slide down), until you slide the lock off. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Lock your messages
patches_modified.description: Covers your inbox and chats, all of Instagram, or just the single chats you pick under Locked chats, until your fingerprint, face or screen lock says it's you. patches_modified.name: Long press to zoom
patches_modified.description: Press and hold a photo in a feed to see it twice as big around your finger, and let go to close it. Pinch to zoom still works. patches_modified.name: Loop a story
patches_modified.description: Plays a story again from the start when it ends, instead of moving on to the next one. Tap or swipe to move on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Open developer options
patches_modified.description: A long press on the Home tab opens Instagram's own developer options, where you can change its hidden settings. A wrong change can break parts of Instagram until you reset it. On once you patch it in. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Developer.

patches_modified.name: Open links in external browser
patches_modified.description: Opens web links you tap in your usual browser instead of Instagram's built-in one, without Instagram's click tracker. Instagram pages and ads still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Profile posts as a list
patches_modified.description: Opening someone's profile takes you on to their posts as a scrolling list of full posts. Back shows the grid. Your own profile keeps its grid. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Pure black dark mode
patches_modified.description: Makes Instagram's dark mode pure black instead of dark gray, on the menus that slide up from the bottom too. It looks deeper and can save battery on an OLED screen. Buttons keep their grays so they stay easy to see. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Makes Instagram's dark mode pure black instead of dark gray. It looks deeper and can save battery on an OLED screen. Menus and buttons keep their grays so they stay easy to see. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Read messages without the seen receipt
patches_modified.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you've seen their messages. You still see when they've seen yours. Mark as read still tells them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Remove build expired popup
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from locking you out with a screen that says this version is too old. A patched build can't update itself, so it would stop working after a few weeks. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from reading your phone's advertising ID, which ad companies use to follow you between apps. Instagram gets a string of zeros instead. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Remove the empty space at the bottom
patches_modified.description: Takes away the empty gap Instagram leaves under its tab bar for a navigation bar that isn't there. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: Restore trust on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Lets Instagram's own checks of who signed the app pass on a patched build, so the parts that need them keep working. Threads, Facebook and Messenger patched with the same key work too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Resume long videos
patches_modified.description: A video or reel longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time you play it on the same account. Live videos and ads start as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Rounded post corners
patches_modified.description: Rounds the corners of a post's photo, video and carousel pages in Home and Following, at a small or large size. Stories, profiles, Explore and Reels stay as Instagram draws them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags from the links you copy or share, and opens bio links without Instagram's click tracker. The link still opens the same post, reel, story or profile. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Save comment photo
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the menu on a comment that has its own photo or GIF, saving the largest size Instagram sent. A GIF is saved as a .gif in Pictures/Instagram, taken from Instagram's own copy, not Giphy. If Instagram lists only an animated WebP or an MP4 for it, you get that file instead, and an MP4 goes in Movies/Instagram like a video. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Save profile picture
patches_modified.description: Adds Save profile picture, View profile picture, Copy username and Copy bio to the menu on someone's profile. View opens the picture full screen and lets you zoom. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Saved on your profile
patches_modified.description: Adds a bookmark to the tabs on your own profile, beside posts, reels and tagged, that opens Saved. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles, then restart Instagram.

patches_modified.name: See who a story mentions
patches_modified.description: Adds a small label in a story's header showing how many accounts it mentions. Tap it for a list and tap an account to open their profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Show a post's exact time
patches_modified.description: Shows the date and time a post went up, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. It does the same for comments. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Show a story's exact time

patches_modified.name: Show hidden like counts
patches_modified.description: Shows how many likes a post or reel has when its owner hid the count, as long as Instagram's server still sends the number. If it doesn't, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Show if a profile follows you

patches_modified.name: Show when someone was last active

patches_modified.name: Spoof location

patches_modified.name: Start Home on Following

patches_modified.name: Start feed videos with sound

patches_modified.name: Start on x86 devices

patches_modified.name: Start stories with sound

patches_modified.name: Stop Story auto-advance

patches_modified.name: Stop background wake-ups

patches_modified.name: Stop swipe to create

patches_modified.name: Stop swiping between tabs

patches_modified.name: [Tab] Hide LINE TODAY tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the LINE TODAY (News) tab from the main bottom navigation, in both the news-tab and news-row layouts.

patches_modified.name: [Tab] Hide Shopping tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Shopping tab from the main bottom navigation. This includes the Japan variant (Shopping, ショッピング) and the Taiwan variant (Discover, 逛逛).

patches_modified.name: [Tab] Hide VOOM tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the VOOM (formerly Timeline) tab from the main bottom navigation.

patches_modified.name: [Tab] Hide Wallet tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Wallet (LINE Pay) tab from the main bottom navigation, in both the normal and mini-tab layouts.

patches_modified.name: [Ad] Hide ad views
patches_modified.description: Hides LINE display ads: the LINE Ads banners, the Smart Channel banner in the chat list and Google AdManager ads.

patches_modified.name: [Ad] Remove banner ads
patches_modified.description: LINE no longer loads the Smart Channel banner ads. This patch makes the getBanners and getPrefetchableBanners responses null.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Hide AI Friends button
patches_modified.description: Removes the AI Friends button from the Chats tab header. The Album button shows in its place.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Hide Events button
patches_modified.description: Removes the "Events" row from the slide-out menu in a chat room. Events is a different feature from LINE Calendar, and it opens a server-hosted page.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Hide LINE GIFT button
patches_modified.description: Removes the LINE GIFT tile from the + attach menu in a chat room.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Hide Transfer button
patches_modified.description: Removes the Transfer (LINE Pay) tile from the + attach menu in a chat room.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Hide attach menu extra tools
patches_modified.description: Removes the server-provided tools (Poll, Schedule and more) from the + menu in a chat. Built-in tiles stay.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Hide calendar buttons
patches_modified.description: Removes every LINE Calendar button: in the Chats tab, the chat toolbar and menus, and the Home tab.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Hide community button
patches_modified.description: Removes the community (OpenChat) button from the top of the Chats tab header.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Hide tips under messages
patches_modified.description: Hides the "CHECK" tips under some messages, such as a received video.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Keep chats unread
patches_modified.description: When you open a chat, LINE does not mark it read or send a read receipt. "Mark as read" still works.

patches_modified.name: [Chat] Keep unsent messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps messages that others unsend in 1:1 and group chats, with a notice below each one. OpenChat is not covered.

patches_modified.name: [Fix] Restore chat backup sign-in via MicroG-RE
patches_modified.description: Makes Google Drive chat backup and restore work on a re-signed build, through MicroG-RE. Root Mount does not need it.

patches_modified.name: [Fix] Restore location maps via MicroG-RE
patches_modified.description: Shows maps again on a re-signed build, with OpenFreeMap tiles. It needs MicroG-RE 7.0.0 or later. Root Mount does not need it.

patches_modified.name: [Fix] Restore push notifications
patches_modified.description: When LINE is fully closed, push notifications work again on a re-signed build. A Root Mount install does not need this patch.

patches_modified.name: [General] Andrew's Patch Setting
patches_modified.description: Adds "Andrew's Patch Setting" to LINE Settings, below "Profile". There you can turn some patches on or off without patching again, and see the credits and licenses.

patches_modified.name: [General] Disable VOOM
patches_modified.description: VOOM deep links, shares, and notifications do nothing. If you open the standalone VOOM feed, it closes. Messaging and the other tabs do not change.

patches_modified.name: [General] Hide Agent i buttons
patches_modified.description: Removes the Agent i button from the Home header and from the search bar.

patches_modified.name: [General] Hide new item badges
patches_modified.description: Hides the green dots and N badges that mark new items, on header buttons, tabs, menus, lists and settings rows. Unread message counts do not change.

patches_modified.name: [General] Open links in external browser
patches_modified.description: Opens web links in your default browser instead of LINE's in-app browser. LIFF mini-apps and LINE links stay in LINE.

patches_modified.name: [General] Redirect LINE Pay
patches_modified.description: Opens LINE Pay in the standalone LINE Pay app, so the integrity check that fails on a re-signed build never runs.

patches_modified.name: [General] Trust user-installed CAs
patches_modified.description: Makes LINE trust certificate authorities you install, so your own HTTPS proxy can read LIFF and mini-app web traffic. Bank and LINE Pay stay pinned. For debugging. Off by default.

patches_modified.name: [Home] Hide Home content feed
patches_modified.description: Removes the content feed below the friends list on the Home tab: LINE NEWS, official account posts and rankings.

patches_modified.name: [Home] Hide Home modules
patches_modified.description: Hides the recommended content, hot-topics and ad modules on the Home tab.

patches_modified.name: [Premium] Disable LINE Premium
patches_modified.description: Hides all LINE Premium upsells, badges and pages. It unlocks nothing, because the server enforces Premium.

patches_modified.name: [Premium] Hide premium unsend upsells
patches_modified.description: Removes the Premium unsend upsells that "Disable LINE Premium" leaves. Ordinary unsend still works.
